description_en: Queries the remaining bandwidth of a specified bandwidth plan instance
description_zh: 查询指定带宽包实例的剩余带宽值
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-geographic-span-remaining-bandwidth --cen-id cen-nh98vzx8gfhlwn0000 --geographic-regiona-id China --geographic-regionb-id North-America --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the bandwidth plan is attached
parameters.help_zh: 带宽包实例绑定的云企业网实例ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of one of the connected areas of the bandwidth plan instance. Valid values:

China: the Chinese mainland.
North-America: North America.
Asia-Pacific: Asia Pacific.
Europe: Europe
parameters.help_zh:
带宽包实例的一个互通区域ID，取值：

China：中国内地。
North-America：北美。
Asia-Pacific：亚太。
Europe：欧洲
parameters.name: geographic_regiona_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the other connected areas of the bandwidth plan instance. Valid values:

China: the Chinese mainland.
North-America: North America.
Asia-Pacific: Asia Pacific.
Europe: Europe
parameters.help_zh:
带宽包实例的另一个互通区域ID。取值：

China：中国内地。
North-America：北美。
Asia-Pacific：亚太。
Europe：欧洲
parameters.name: geographic_regionb_id

RemainingBandwidth.description_en: The remaining bandwidth of the bandwidth plan instance. Unit: Mbit/s
RemainingBandwidth.description_zh: 带宽包实例的剩余带宽值。单位：Mbps
